tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark: the Adriatic after sunset. Light: Dalmatian limestone. Ground of every YouTube thumbnail (dark value).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, code blocks, video tiles, menus.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card and input borders, table rules.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control: secondary buttons, inputs, checkboxes. Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, reading time, captions and metadata, on either surface.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: The brand colour, the Adriatic. Primary action, links, active nav item, the highlighted word in a thumbnail. As text: on surface, surface-raised or sea-soft.

tokens.name: sea-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind sea text: callouts, the selected tag.

tokens.name: on-sea
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a sea fill (the primary button's label).

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Second colour, the olive leaf. Success, "shipped" and "in production" states, the AI topic tag. Never a button fill. As text: on surface, surface-raised or olive-soft.

tokens.name: olive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind olive text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links; an alias of sea.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Newsreader: a calm editorial serif for headlines. Medium weight, never bold.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Hanken Grotesk for reading and UI.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: OAuth for internal tools, done properly
styles.usage: Card titles, h3, thumbnail text (scaled up, 800 weight).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The agent only gets the scopes the user already has, and every call is logged.
styles.usage: Blog body text, at most 68 characters wide.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: A CLI that rotates AWS keys before they leak.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: JetBrains Mono, the same face as Rasmus's terminal.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside inputs, between tags.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: Soft like worn stone, never bubbly.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, inline code.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, code blocks, photos.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatar and pill tags.

shadow.note: No elevation shadows: depth comes from surface-raised and hairlines. The one shadow is the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px of solid sea (box-shadow, so it follows the radius).
